text:
mira: midday micro-pulse — quick status
mira: done: triaged Snyk PRs, kicked off a KMS key rotation dry-run in staging, updated the compliance audit spreadsheet
mira: blocker: staging dry-run failed with AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt for service account redwood-svc-runner — need a tiny IAM tweak
mira: pinging @sam to adjust the policy, and @lee for SRE role mapping verification
sam: on it, digging into the role binding now. initial guess: role missing kms:Decrypt scoped to the key alias
sam: creating a minimal policy change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/492 (WIP)
sam: will re-run dry-run after CI
lee: heads up — we have a small infra deployment at 15:00 PT. prefer to hold rotation until after 16:00 PT canary window. not a hard block, just reduces blast radius
jordan: added a quick staging smoke test for the rotation workflow:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging-redwood.internal/health || echo "health failed"
```
nana: security note: Snyk flagged a low severity path traversal in vendor lib X — opened ticket SEC-3412 and linked remediation guidance
mira: thanks @ana — tagging as low priority backlog, not blocking the rotation itself
deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/pr-492 -> staging after CI :rocket: (watch CI run at https://ci.redwood.example.com/492)
sam: CI passed, applied policy patch to staging role, re-running the dry-run now
sam: quick log snippet from the dry-run: 
```
2026-03-17T19:22:10Z rotation: attempting decrypt with key alias redwood/staging/rot1
2026-03-17T19:22:10Z rotation: kms:Decrypt OK for principal arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/redwood-svc-runner
```

mira: verified: decrypt succeeded, staging dry-run completed without errors. scheduling actual rotation for 21:00 PT with a 30m canary
lee: :thumbsup: will monitor canary window and hold any further deploys for that timeslot
jordan: I pushed a tiny smoke-test addition to the rotation job: if KMS decrypt fails, it automatically triggers revert and alerts #incidents
mira: today: finalize rotation schedule in calendar, merge infra PR, update rotation runbook with the canary checklist, follow up on SEC-3412 remediation plan
mira: any objections to merging infra/pr-492 at EOD?
sam: no objections, good to merge once CI is green and runbook updated
ana: fine by me
lee: ok from SRE side
mira: great — I'll merge after lunch and post an update here before the 21:00 window
mira: thanks everyone!
